questions.question: Explain the difference between composition and inheritance.
questions.answer: Composition is a has-a relationship where a class contains instances of other classes. Inheritance is an is-a relationship where a class extends another. Composition is more flexible - you can change behavior at runtime, avoid tight coupling, and do not break encapsulation. Inheritance creates tight coupling and fragile base class problem. Example: Car has Engine (composition) vs Car is a Vehicle (inheritance).
